FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Value & Military Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue with item value when creating units, and slightly nerfs npc military values.

patchNoteLines.li: Nerfed military efficiency for NPCs: Neolithic 1 -> .9, Medieval 1.2 -> 1, Industrial 1.2 -> 1.1, Spacer 1.3 -> 1.2
Bugfix: non-stuffable items would show incorrect market values in the manage units window

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manage Units Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Cleans up a UI issue in the Manage Units window.

patchNoteLines.li: Changes Manage Units window so that the "Equipped Apparel" label won't overlap with the "Clear Colors" button
